exact_statement: For every Boolean sign f under a finite independent interior product law and finite deterministic fresh-coordinate singleton stopping tree with transcript Pi, let R=I_phys(f)-E I_phys(f_leaf). On the coherent root-spectrum lift, append any finite Z=(W,A) by one conditional root law P(Z|S0) and retain Z->S0->Pi. With o=I(Y;Pi), j_Z=I(Z;Pi), Gamma_Z=H(Pi|Y)-H(Pi|Z), one has Gamma_Z=j_Z-o, o<=R, j_Z<=4R/ln2, and o/2+[Gamma_Z]_+/2=max(o,j_Z)/2<=2R/ln2; uniform inputs sharpen j_Z<=2R/ln2 and the joint bound to R/ln2. Consequently any charge B<=o/2+H(Pi|Y)/2 obeys B<=H(Pi|Z)/2+2R/ln2 (uniform R/ln2). Compatible fair point-defect computing trees have Gamma_S0/(2I)->3/4, and r=5 certifies Gamma_S0/(2I)>1/2. Without the root-Markov hypothesis, setting A_future=Pi after the first essential query on fair r-bit point defects makes the conversion/(2R) unbounded. No conditional-history bank supply, arbitrary reset payment, or universal Fourier entropy-influence bound is established.
